# Data

LOLA was performed for DM, hyper-, and hypomethylated Cgs between the stomach regions using all Cgs of the normalized data set as the universe.

Here I visualize the all results, including the collections 

* Cistrome Epigenome
* Encode Segmentation
* Encode TFBS
* UCSC Features
* Roadmap Epigenome
* Jaspar TF binding sites

```{r}
# Combine results from core + extended data bases
load( "../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE210994_Leung_IMO/LOLA_Core_results.Rdata")

# Fix logOddsRatio/OddsRatio columns - this is only necessary when using our own LOLA enrichment function which is based on previous, errorneous code from LOLA
all_results_lola_core <- lapply(all_results_lola, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("logOddsRatio","OddsRatio", colnames(x))  
  x$logOddsRatio <- log2(x$OddsRatio)
  
  x$untreated = with(x, !complete.cases(treatment) | treatment == "None" | treatment == "No treatment" | treatment == "regular medium" | treatment == "serum_starved_media" | treatment == "serum_stimulated_media" | treatment == "full media" | treatment == "mock" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RAR _A704)" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RXR _sc774)" )
  
  return(x)
  
} )

load( "../../../../Data/ExtData/Other_Methylation_data/GSE210994_Leung_IMO/LOLA_Ext_results.Rdata")
# Fix logOddsRatio/OddsRatio columns - this is only necessary when using our own LOLA enrichment function which is based on previous, errorneous code from LOLA
all_results_lola_ext <- lapply(all_results_lola, function(x) {
  colnames(x) <- gsub("logOddsRatio","OddsRatio", colnames(x))  
  x$logOddsRatio <- log2(x$OddsRatio)
  
  x$untreated = with(x, !complete.cases(treatment) | treatment == "None" | treatment == "No treatment" | treatment == "regular medium" | treatment == "serum_starved_media" | treatment == "serum_stimulated_media" | treatment == "full media" | treatment == "mock" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RAR _A704)" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RXR _sc774)" )
  
  return(x)
  
} )

all_results_lola_combined <- mapply(function(x,y) rbind(x,y), all_results_lola_core, all_results_lola_ext, SIMPLIFY = F)
rm(all_results_lola, all_results_lola_core, all_results_lola_ext)

all_results_lola_combined <- lapply(all_results_lola_combined, function(x) {
  x$label = ifelse(x$collection %in% c("cistrome_cistrome", "cistrome_epigenome","ucsc_features","sheffield_dnase","encode_tfbs"), gsub("cistrome_cistrome |cistrome_epigenome ", "", x$description), 
                   ifelse(x$collection=="encode_segmentation", paste0(x$description, "_", x$cellType),
                          ifelse(x$collection == "codex", paste0(x$cellType, "_", x$antibody), 
                                 ifelse(x$collection == "roadmap_epigenomics", ifelse(x$description == "roadmap_epigenomics", "DNase", gsub("roadmap_epigenomics ", "", x$description)), 
                                        ifelse(x$description=="jaspar_motifs", gsub("\\.bed","", x$filename), "__MISSING__"  )))));
    
  x$factor = ifelse(x$collection %in% c("cistrome_cistrome", "cistrome_epigenome","encode_tfbs", "codex"), x$antibody, 
                   ifelse(x$collection=="encode_segmentation", x$description,
                          ifelse(x$collection == "sheffield_dnase", "DNase", 
                                 ifelse(x$collection == "ucsc_features", x$description, 
                                 ifelse(x$collection == "roadmap_epigenomics", ifelse(x$description == "roadmap_epigenomics", "DNase", x$antibody), 
                                        ifelse(x$description=="jaspar_motifs", gsub("\\.bed","", x$filename), "__MISSING__"  ))))));
  x$ID = paste0(x$collection, "_", x$description) |> make.unique()
  return(x)
})

```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (n in names(all_results_lola_combined)) {
  tmp <- all_results_lola_combined[[n]] |> as.data.frame()
  for (d in unique(tmp$collection)) {
    #sig <- subset(tmp, collection == d & p.adj < 0.05)
    sig <- tmp[(tmp$collection==d & tmp$p.adj < 0.05),]
    sig$label = make.unique(sig$label)
    head(sig, 20) |> (\(x) {
      x$logOddsRatio_fixed <- ifelse(is.infinite(x$logOddsRatio), sign(x$logOddsRatio) * 20, x$logOddsRatio)
      #barplot(x$logOddsRatio_fixed, names.arg = x$filename, main=unique(x$collection), las=2 ) 
      x<-x[order(x$logOddsRatio_fixed, decreasing = T),]
      x$label = factor(x$label, levels = unique(x$label))
      p <- ggplot(x, aes(x=label, y=logOddsRatio_fixed, fill=factor)) + geom_bar(stat="identity") + ggtitle(paste0(n, " - ", unique(x$collection))) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust = 1)) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-5,5))
      print(p)
    } )()
  }
}
```
